info.name: LuvuPay · Hero flow + API tests
info.description:
Import this file AND LuvuPay.postman_environment.json, pick the environment, then press Run on the collection.

1) Hero flow (console session): sign in → AI proposes → human lowers the donation → PayPal Payouts → evidence → ledger. Folder order matters.
2) Merchant API (API key): idempotency, auth and AI endpoints.
3) Security checks: forged webhook, no-session access, unguessable evidence ids.

The donation recipient is an EXAMPLE and PayPal Sandbox moves test money only. Set the variable require_real=false to run against the mock driver.
